programme.title: Computer Science Bachelor of Arts
programme.degree: BA in Computer Science; fall intake
programme.how_found: EECS department site, Undergraduate Admissions & Programs. University-wide admissions pages (admissions.berkeley.edu) used for english, gpa, deadline; registrar for fees; financial aid office for the scholarship (owner ruling: US university-wide pages acceptable).
programme.notes: Course page: 'Students interested in CS should apply directly to the major on the University of California Application for Admission.' The EECS BS (Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences, College of Engineering) is a separate, related degree.

english.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) with a minimum score of 90/4.5 or better International English Language testing System (IELTS) with a minimum score of 6.5 DuoLingo English Test (DET) with a minimum score of 115
english.notes: University-wide (Requirements for International Students, 'English Proficiency Exams and Minimum Score Requirements'). No per-section minimums published. Scores valid for 2 years from enrollment; proficiency by January 31. Other routes: AP/IB English scores, SAT ERW etc.

value.value: 3.4 GPA in A-G courses taken in the 10th and 11th grade years (non-residents)
value.description: UC minimum: 3.0 GPA in A-G courses in 10th and 11th grade; 3.4 for non-residents. Admission is competitive and holistic.

gpa.quote: Have a 3.0 GPA in A-G courses taken in the 10th and 11th grade years. (3.4 GPA for non-residents)
gpa.notes: Grade threshold on the school record, 4.0 scale (UC A-G GPA). International page says 'Do not attempt to convert your grades' - grades are reported on the school's own scale and evaluated by an International Admission Specialist, so the 3.4 cannot be applied to a foreign scale without UC's own conversion. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

deadline.quote: The application filing period is October 1 – November 30. All applications must be submitted by November 30.
deadline.notes: University-wide, one deadline for all first-year applicants including international ('Applications for admission are available beginning in October of the year prior to the year in which you would enter'), so fall 2027 entry -> 30 November 2026. The year is NOT printed on the page; no time zone given.

extra_quotes: (Note: Estimated fees below are per semester.)
tuition.notes: Undergraduate Fee Schedule, 2026-27 Cohort, Nonresidents column, PER SEMESTER (not multiplied): total of tuition 7,101 + Nonresident Supplemental Tuition 19,635 + campus fees + health insurance 2,533 + one-time document fee 250. No 2027-28 schedule is published. Not per year.

scholarship_exists.quote: The Regents’ & Chancellor’s Scholarship is the most prestigious scholarship offered by UC Berkeley to entering undergraduate students.
scholarship_exists.notes: Merit, competitive, automatic consideration (no separate application). Amount not stated on the page (not sized).

scholarship_international.quote: All students who apply to UC Berkeley are automatically considered for the scholarship. This includes California resident, out-of-state, and international students entering from high school as well as transfer students.
scholarship_international.notes: Explicit: international first-year applicants are considered automatically. Competitive; amount unpublished.
